name: Nemuri Clinic
description: Nemuri Clinic is a calm, low-key WordPress theme designed for an evening sleep-medicine clinic for working adults. It features documentary photography layouts, sticky-media diagnostic panels, transparent fee schedules, and distinctive architectural curves. Built with clear typography and responsive structures, it offers an unhurried digital experience tailored to specialized healthcare practices.

store.withoutPlugin: The theme works without WooCommerce; fees are listed on the Fees page and visits are booked by phone.
